title: Read-only reviewer delegations refuse `git ls-tree`, a read-only Git inspection command
outcome: Read-only reviewer delegations refuse `git ls-tree`, a read-only Git inspection command
acceptance: In a delegation with writePolicy readOnly, `git ls-tree <tree-ish> <paths>` (and other read-only plumbing used to compare blobs, such as `git rev-parse <rev>:<path>`) is allowed
Commands that can write (for example `git update-index`, `git write-tree` into the object store, or anything that changes refs, index or worktree) stay refused
A test covers the allowed read-only git inspection forms and at least one refused writing form
